decisions.name: Elaboration beyond the inciting gimmick
decisions.audit_reason: Developing beyond the inciting gimmick versus restating one beat is depth-of-craft.

decisions.name: Causal escalation
decisions.audit_reason: Escalating, causally linked beats versus merely appended incidents is core plot craft.

decisions.name: Self-sufficient: no prior installment, source work or link required
decisions.audit_reason: Tests whether the story is self-contained and intelligible on its own terms; a clarity/craft matter.

decisions.name: Moral complication
decisions.audit_reason: Complicating easy moral judgment versus announced good/evil is thematic craft depth.

decisions.name: No mutual-knowledge exposition; information arrives under pressure
decisions.audit_reason: Penalizes info-dump exposition, rewards dramatized delivery of information; a clarity/craft signal.

decisions.name: Recontextualizing ending
decisions.audit_reason: Whether the ending recontextualizes earlier detail is a structural payoff/craft judgment.

decisions.name: Functional sensory detail
decisions.audit_reason: Sensory detail scored by narrative function (reveals danger/mood/character) is a craft signal.

decisions.name: Distinctive narrating idiom, scored with mechanics disregarded
decisions.audit_reason: Distinctive narrating idiom, mechanics explicitly disregarded, isolates voice as a craft quality independent of surface polish.

decisions.name: Distinctive character voice
decisions.audit_reason: Distinct, consistent character voice via diction/rhythm/dialogue is core characterization craft.

decisions.name: Productive restraint / ambiguity
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether withheld explanation deepens meaning; a deliberate-ambiguity craft judgment.

decisions.name: Concrete sensory/physical grounding
decisions.audit_reason: Rewards concrete sensory grounding over abstract summary; a genuine show-don't-tell craft signal.

decisions.name: At least one invented rule or institution drives the scene
decisions.audit_reason: Rewards invented, load-bearing worldbuilding over off-the-shelf genre furniture; an originality/craft signal.

decisions.name: Formal/structural risk that serves the content
decisions.audit_reason: Formal risk is only rewarded when it does real work for the content; a craft judgment.

decisions.name: Psychological contradiction
decisions.audit_reason: Credible internal conflict in motives/self-image is genuine characterization depth.

decisions.name: Narrative economy
decisions.audit_reason: Every detail earning its place versus digression/filler is a classic unity-of-craft measure.

decisions.name: Institutional community framing
decisions.audit_reason: Counts references to mods/contests/community rules; platform embedding, not story quality.

decisions.name: Inline links and continuation markers to the author's earlier instalments
decisions.audit_reason: Counts links/instalment markers to the author's other posts; a series/platform fingerprint, not story quality.

decisions.name: Copyedit-level consistency
decisions.audit_reason: Pure spelling/grammar/tense consistency is surface-form polish, explicitly separated elsewhere from voice/quality.

decisions.name: Direct-address paratext / meta notes outside the fiction
decisions.audit_reason: Detects author asides/sign-offs outside the fiction; platform paratext, not evidence of the story's quality.

decisions.name: Author self-promotion footer plugging a personal subreddit
decisions.audit_reason: Counts self-promotional footer/CTA furniture; author marketing behavior, not story quality.

decisions.name: Self-positioning disclaimers
decisions.audit_reason: Counts author's self-deprecating disclaimers/novice framing; an author-fingerprint, not story quality.

decisions.name: Dialogue-first opening within first two lines
decisions.audit_reason: Detects a formal opening gimmick (dialogue in first two lines) without judging whether it works.

decisions.name: Document or chat framing
decisions.audit_reason: Classifies prose-vs-document container without asking whether the form serves the content; a format/fashion marker.

decisions.name: Paragraph-count tally
decisions.audit_reason: Explicitly counts paragraphs only, disregarding whether anything develops; pure surface-form tally.

decisions.name: Sentence-final ellipsis count
decisions.audit_reason: Counts ellipsis punctuation only, explicitly ignoring meaning; a mechanical surface tally.
